title: End a Deploy App in Fleet
breadcrumb: End a Deploy App in Fleet

slides.title: What ending removes
slides.html: In the connector, ending deletes two things in Fleet: the team's certificate, named rmscep, and the Deploy App's authority, unless another team uses it. The team, its phones, their names and their apps stay.

slides.title: By hand: the certificate
slides.html: Without the connector: choose your team at the top, then Controls, OS settings, Certificates. On rmscep open Actions, choose Delete and confirm: every phone of that team drops the certificate, and it cannot be undone.

slides.title: By hand: the authority
slides.html: Then Settings, Integrations, Certificate enrollment: delete your Deploy App's authority, the one named under rmscep on the first slide. If Fleet refuses, another team's certificate still uses it: leave it.

slides.title: The next Deploy App
slides.html: At Connect for your next Deploy App, type the old team's name on Team, such as golden-monkey DeployApp. Each named phone in it then asks for the new certificate while enrolment is open.

slides.title: The next one, by hand
slides.html: By hand, make no new team: add the new Deploy App's authority and certificate to the same team, and put its address in the policy and in Google Chrome's setting, as in Set Fleet up without the connector.

slides.title: Apps and the icon
slides.html: A phone gets apps and the Deploy App icon only when it enrols, so a kept phone's icon still opens the old Deploy App. For the new one, remove its work profile before you connect the next Deploy App, and enrol it again after.
